Blocked numbers

Güven Phone Help Guide, version 2.0.22

Open Blocked Numbers in the Permissions and Privacy section of Settings.

Block only this number blocks one number; entering it with the country code is recommended.

Block numbers starting with these digits blocks every number that starts with certain digits. For example, entering 0850212 blocks all numbers starting with those digits.

With Show in Recent Calls on, blocked calls also appear in the Recent Calls list.

You can also block or unblock a number from the actions menu in Contacts or Recent Calls.
